title: Attitude: assertive
instructions: Choose the word that best preserves the exact meaning, degree and attitude supported by the sentence.

parts.prompt: Rina was ___ during the meeting: she stated her evidence clearly, disagreed without insulting anyone and invited questions.

choice_rationales.A: Assertive describes expressing a view clearly and confidently while respecting other people.
choice_rationales.B: Aggressive adds hostile or forceful behaviour, which the respectful disagreement rules out.
choice_rationales.C: Arrogant implies an inflated sense of superiority, which is not supported by inviting questions.
choice_rationales.D: Argumentative criticises a tendency to quarrel, while the sentence shows controlled evidence-based disagreement.

parts.hint: Predict ‘confident and clear, but respectful’ before comparing the attitudes carried by the options.
parts.correct_explanation: ‘Assertive’ preserves both the confident core meaning and the respectful attitude established by the evidence.
